snippet.title: IFO Official Trailer
snippet.description:
IFO (Identified flying object) is an ever changing short puzzle game about figuring out how to control an alien spaceship. Experiment, learn and end the entrusted mission! 

Wishlist now!  https://store.steampowered.com/app/1876000/IFO/

A game by Le Slo, with programming by Fernando García and audio design by Sergi Sabater.
